_comment: SYNTHETIC fixture in the shape of a GET https://pensero.ai/api/v1/delivery?start_date=2026-08-01&end_date=2026-08-04&team_identifiers=Engineering response. People, emails, usernames, titles and scores are invented; each row exists because it demonstrates a named extraction/matching hazard (see _hazards). This file is the parser's hazard suite, not a volume sample.

_hazards.H1_creator_row_has_no_pr_number: item_type=pull_request rows carry only the bare PR title. Only pull_request_review rows embed '<owner>/<repo>#<number>'.
_hazards.H2_url_is_the_intra_feed_join_key: creator and reviewer rows for one PR share url=/interactions/pull_request/<id>. That is the ONLY way to get a creator row's PR number.
_hazards.H3_creator_with_no_reviewer_counterpart: some creator rows have no review row in the window, so no number is recoverable from this segment at all.
_hazards.H5_title_not_unique: two distinct PRs share a byte-identical creator title.
_hazards.H6_title_is_lossy: markup is stripped, leaving a double space where <main> was. Pensero title != GitHub title.
_hazards.H7_nested_quotes_in_title: the review title wraps the PR title in single quotes while the PR title itself contains apostrophes and quotes.
_hazards.H8_zero_is_a_measured_value: delivery: 0 is real, and must stay distinct from unmatched and from not-yet-backfilled.
_hazards.H9_points_split_across_roles_and_people: one PR yields a creator row plus N reviewer rows to different users; the creator may also appear as their own reviewer.
_hazards.H10_non_pr_item_types: messaging (url null) and ticket (/ticketing/ticket/<id>) carry real points with no PR to attach to.
_hazards.H11_no_github_login: user object has only id/name/email/username; username is email-shaped and differs in case from email. Person identity must bridge on email, case-insensitively.
_hazards.H12_empty_deliveries_is_present_not_abse: a user with deliveries: [] is in the payload.
_hazards.H13_delivery_date_is_not_the_pr_date: a window returns rows for PRs created well before it, so points accrete across windows; upsert on item_id, never sum on re-read.
_hazards.H14_multi_slug_titles_are_truncated: '+ N more' and slash-runs under-report which tickets a PR touches; the artifact set must come from our own links, not this string.
_hazards.H15_legacy_slugs: FEA- slugs appear and must resolve via legacy_slug.
_hazards.H16_partial_credit_markers: (item 1), (Part 1), (PR1) mark a PR that addresses only part of its ticket. A link is not a completion claim.
_hazards.H17_hash_in_title_that_is_not_a_pr_ref: '#team-ci-alerts' is a Slack channel, not a PR number.
